validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, independently confirmed -- FERC docket CP22-44 (FR-2022-05-27 scoping notice, FR-2023-01-31 final-EIS notice, FERC.gov EIS news release), EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (row 1173, docket CP22-44), operator's own SEC 8-K disclosures (Q1 2024 results), P&GJ trade press (2023-08), and the operator's ovcx.info project site (Wayback-archived). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correctly an interstate natural-gas transmission expansion (EIA 'Interstate', FERC NGA section 7 certificate), not gathering. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of any roster row -- it is the 2022-filed FERC-certificated EXPANSION of the original 2016 Ohio Valley Connector system (P6897, docket CP15-41; see cross_row_leads), reusing/upgrading the same Corona (Wetzel Co., WV) and Plasma (Monroe Co., OH) compressor stations that P6897 built, plus new compression and new pipe at a new Greene Co., PA location (Cygrymus Compressor Station). SPEC: Capacity (350 MMcf/d), Length (5.5-6.0 mi), Diameter (12,24 in), SegmentCost ($160-161M), and StartYear1 (2024) all agree across EIA, SEC, and P&GJ within rounding -- no material spec concern. The one real finding is Location/attribution (filed separately below) and a route-accuracy note (also below).

validity.recommendation: correct StartState/Province from 'Ohio' to 'Pennsylvania'; EndState/Province='Ohio' is correct as recorded
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet records StartState/Province=Ohio AND EndState/Province=Ohio, i.e. an entirely-Ohio project. Every independent source disagrees: EIA row 1173 gives 'Beg_State = PA', 'End_State = OH', 'State(s) = PA,WV,OH'; the FR scoping notice (FR-2022-05-27) and final-EIS notice (FR-2023-01-31) both itemize new/modified facilities in Greene County, PA (Cygrymus Compressor Station + ~0.5 mi new 16-in pipe + ~0.5 mi new 12-in pipe), Wetzel County, WV (Corona Compressor Station + ~3.7 mi new 24-in pipe), and Monroe County, OH (Plasma Compressor Station, compression only, no new pipe). The project's true footprint is PA (start, new compressor + most of the new small-diameter pipe) -> WV (most of the new large-diameter pipe) -> OH (end, compression only). EndState/Province=Ohio is therefore correct; StartState/Province=Ohio is wrong and should read Pennsylvania. This is a material attribution/location error, not a rounding nuance.

cross_row_leads.facts: EIA row 827 ('related' match, docket CP15-41): 'Ohio Valley Connector' (the original, pre-expansion project) -- Equitrans, Expansion, Status=Completed (Completed@2018-05), in-service 2016, WV,OH, 50 mi, 24,30 in diameter, $415M, docket CP15-41.
